description: This file defines a Flutter widget called CategoryPieChart that displays a pie chart representing categorized spending data. It includes classes for segments and custom painting logic for the pie chart, along with UI elements for legends.

classes.name: CategoryPieChart
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a pie chart of expense categories based on provided data.

classes.name: _Segment
classes.description: A helper class representing individual segments of the pie chart.

classes.name: _PiePainter
classes.description: A CustomPainter responsible for rendering the pie segments onto the canvas.

methods.name: _hexToColor
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to a Color object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, generating pie segments and rendering the chart with labels.
